title: 2026专硕英语 Unit 3 单词测试及校订

units.text:
原测试第1题
Following the severe head trauma, the patient exhibited ___ to time and place and was unable to recognize family members, a classic sign of concussion.
学习版修订题干：Following a head injury, the patient exhibited ___ to time and place and had difficulty recognizing family members.
原文件答案：disorientation
校订后参考答案：disorientation
定向障碍
disorientation to time and place指对时间和地点的定向障碍；dis-表达异常/失去，-ation提示名词。
来源：26级专硕英语单词测试U3new手机版.html

原测试第2题
During the acute phase of delirium, the elderly patient spoke ___ and could not answer even simple questions from the attending physician.

原文件答案：incoherently
校订后参考答案：incoherently
语无伦次地；不连贯地
修饰spoke需副词incoherently，而非形容词incoherent。
来源：26级专硕英语单词测试U3new手机版.html

原测试第3题
Certain over-the-counter medications may ___ the absorption of prescribed antibiotics, so drug interactions must be carefully reviewed.

原文件答案：interfere with
校订后参考答案：interfere with
干扰；妨碍
interfere with absorption表示干扰吸收；with为固定搭配的一部分，不能遗漏。
来源：26级专硕英语单词测试U3new手机版.html

原测试第4题
An abdominal aortic aneurysm can be life-threatening if it is allowed to ___, leading to massive internal hemorrhage.

原文件答案：rupture
校订后参考答案：rupture
破裂；破裂处
allowed to后填动词原形rupture；同词也可作名词。
来源：26级专硕英语单词测试U3new手机版.html

原测试第5题
Prolonged ischemia in the brain tissue can cause ___ neurological damage, which cannot be reversed even after blood flow is restored.

原文件答案：irreversible
校订后参考答案：irreversible
不可逆的；不能恢复原状的
修饰neurological damage用形容词；irreversible与后文cannot be reversed呼应。
来源：26级专硕英语单词测试U3new手机版.html

原测试第6题
Diabetic patients must monitor their blood ___ levels regularly to prevent both hyperglycemia and hypoglycemic episodes.

原文件答案：glucose
校订后参考答案：glucose
葡萄糖
blood glucose levels为血糖水平；glucose不写作glucoses来修饰levels。
来源：26级专硕英语单词测试U3new手机版.html

原测试第7题
Recent molecular studies ___ a specific gene mutation in the pathogenesis of this rare inherited cardiac disorder.

原文件答案：implicate
校订后参考答案：implicate / implicated
提示……与……有关；牵涉
implicate A in B意为提示A参与/与B有关；复数studies可接现在式implicate，原句也允许过去式implicated。
来源：26级专硕英语单词测试U3new手机版.html

原测试第8题
The kidneys play a crucial role in helping to ___ metabolic waste products and excess fluid from the bloodstream.

原文件答案：eliminate
校订后参考答案：eliminate
清除；排除
eliminate waste表示清除废物；helping to后用原形eliminate。
来源：26级专硕英语单词测试U3new手机版.html
